findings.summary: The mistake figures cover a wider set than the token figures beside them
findings.evidence: The mistake count comes from mistake_report(records).by_class, which counts every recorded mistake of the class, including ones not tied to any job. closed_jobs only counts closed request jobs that have invocations. So mistakes_per_closed_job divides one set by another and can overstate the rate. D175 and the module doc say this openly. A tighter alternative would count only mistakes whose job is among the counted closed jobs, and show the rest apart.

summary: The change gives OLY-B-A13-01 a real mechanism. A new module, crates/athena-core/src/context_load.rs, adds up the tokens loaded per landed job for each class of work: input, cache read and cache write of every invocation on a closed request job. Beside that figure it shows the share of the class's closed jobs that landed and the mistakes recorded for the class. `athena status` prints the result as a `context` line, filled through StatusView.context_load. A class with fewer than 3 landed jobs prints nothing, so a thin history does not look like success. In docs/spec.toml the entry now names the module and its test, keeps owner Athena, and its measure ends `status: context`. I ran the new tests in this snapshot and they pass: 4 integration tests that check exact per-class figures, the thin-class case, the spec entry and that setting the mechanism to `none` makes it a gap again; 3 unit tests in context_load; the status.rs test; and 2 display tests. The status-label test, the xtask spec, policy, ci_shards and fingerprint tests also pass. The fmt and clippy runs Athena recorded passed. Athena's recorded `cargo test --locked` failed on one test, `parallel::a_group_of_urgent_items_does_not_start_ahead_of_the_improvement_turn` in athena-cli's drain tests. That test passes here, both alone and as part of the full drain unit (202 of 202). The change touches no drain code, so the CI failure looks flaky and unrelated to this change. CHANGELOG.md gains one line, and docs/decisions.md gains D175 at the end with a Provenance bullet; no existing entry was edited. I found only minor issues, listed below.
